Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[Savage Opress (Errata)]] (PC-E1), game text: “Deploys -1 for each other Sith character on table (limit - 4). Once per game, may exchange a card in hand with a Sith character in Lost Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-042022.pdf Errata Sheet April 2022] (Players Committee), page 1, PDF built 19 April 2022. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF; its transparent areas (where the card underneath shows through) are shown white.

Edits: none.
